whenToUse: One of a small fixed set (about 4–10): content status, currency, department, sort order.
Form fields that share the Input box.
avoidWhen: More than ~10 options or typing helps — use Combobox.
2–5 options worth showing at once — use Radio Group.
a11y: Wrap in Field for the label; typeahead and arrow keys work in the list.
Do not use placeholder as the only label.
